title: cissampelopsis erythrochaeta
intro: Cissampelopsis erythrochaeta, commonly known as the Chinese knotvine, is a plant species in the family Apiaceae. This plant is traditionally used in Chinese medicine to treat various health conditions due to its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antiviral properties.
